cases.name: updates multiple images inside containers
cases.input:
apiVersion: example.com/v1
kind: Foo
metadata:
  name: instance
spec:
  containers:
  - image: nginx:1.2.1
  - image: nginx:2.1.2
cases.expectedOutput:
apiVersion: example.com/v1
kind: Foo
metadata:
  name: instance
spec:
  containers:
  - image: apache@12345
  - image: apache@12345

cases.name: updates inside both containers and initContainers
cases.input:
apiVersion: example.com/v1
kind: Foo
metadata:
  name: instance
spec:
  containers:
  - image: nginx:1.2.1
  - image: tomcat:1.2.3
  initContainers:
  - image: nginx:1.2.1
  - image: apache:1.2.3
cases.expectedOutput:
apiVersion: example.com/v1
kind: Foo
metadata:
  name: instance
spec:
  containers:
  - image: apache:3.2.1
  - image: tomcat:1.2.3
  initContainers:
  - image: apache:3.2.1
  - image: apache:1.2.3

cases.name: updates on multiple depths
cases.input:
apiVersion: example.com/v1
kind: Foo
metadata:
  name: instance
spec:
  containers:
  - image: nginx:1.2.1
  - image: tomcat:1.2.3
  template:
    spec: 
      initContainers:
      - image: nginx:1.2.1
      - image: apache:1.2.3
cases.expectedOutput:
apiVersion: example.com/v1
kind: Foo
metadata:
  name: instance
spec:
  containers:
  - image: apache:3.2.1
  - image: tomcat:1.2.3
  template:
    spec:
      initContainers:
      - image: apache:3.2.1
      - image: apache:1.2.3
